Vietnam · 9–16 Nov · 7 nights · mid-range

Islands, canyons and two Saigon nights

You clear Saigon airport at 11:00 on Monday and fly out at 08:00 the next Monday. Beach first, then the highlands, then back to Saigon in time for Saturday night. No museum circuit.

    Know before you go

    Weather in mid-November

    PlaceFeels like
    SaigonHot, 27–32°C. Dry season is starting.
    Phú Quốc24–30°C, sea ~30°C, calmer and clearer water. Short showers.
    Đà LạtCool days. Nights around 15°C. Pack a hoodie.

    Left out on purpose

    • Hội An / Đà Nẵng: November is central Vietnam's flood and storm month.
    • Cu Chi, War Remnants, Mekong cruises: mostly older tour-bus crowds.
    • Hà Nội / Hà Giang: great in November but too far for 6.5 days on a Saigon return ticket.

    Getting around

    • Install Grab for cars and bikes. Use it everywhere except the Phú Quốc north loop.
    • Get an eSIM before landing, or a Viettel SIM at arrivals.
    • Carry cash (VND) for markets, street food and scooter rental.
    • Saigon domestic flights leave from T1 or the new T3 depending on airline. Check each ticket.

    Paperwork

    • Most passports, Indian included, need an e-visa. Apply only on the government portal, evisa.gov.vn, at least a week ahead.
    • Buy travel insurance that names canyoning and paragliding.

    Scooters: Vietnam requires a valid motorbike licence. Without one, insurance usually won't pay after a crash. If anyone hasn't ridden before, hire a car with driver for the north loop (around $35–45 for the day, split).
